cases.note: narrow a compound fact: the zombie part stays

wrong.content: Creepers and zombies do 10 damage.

claim.content: A creeper explosion does 12 damage to an unarmored player.

wrong.content: Wooden and stone swords do 4 damage per hit.

claim.content: A stone sword does 5 damage per hit.

wrong.content: Zombies and husks burn in sunlight.

claim.content: A husk does not burn in sunlight.
claim.justification: I watched one at noon for ten minutes.

wrong.content: Fire resistance and water breathing potions last 3 minutes.

claim.content: A water breathing potion lasts 2 minutes.

wrong.content: Cows and sheep have 10 health.
wrong.just: I hit each with a 2 damage tool.

claim.content: A sheep has 8 health.

wrong.content: A creeper needs 2 explosions and a zombie needs 7 hits to kill a player.

claim.content: A creeper explosion does 21 damage to an unarmored player.

wrong.content: A skeleton arrow and a bow arrow do 3 damage on normal difficulty.

claim.content: A bow arrow does 6 damage at full draw.

cases.note: the tag that fits the part that stands is kept; the zombie tag fitted the removed part

wrong.content: Zombies and skeletons spawn at night and in caves.

claim.content: Zombies spawn only in the dark, at any time of day.
claim.justification: I met a zombie in a cave at noon, and none outside at noon.

wrong.content: Iron and diamond pickaxes mine gold ore.

claim.content: A stone pickaxe cannot mine gold ore.

wrong.content: Splash potions and lingering potions affect entities within 4 blocks.

claim.content: A lingering potion cloud has a 3 block radius.
claim.justification: I measured the cloud with blocks.

wrong.content: Creepers have 20 health and skeletons have 20 health.

claim.content: A skeleton has 18 health.

wrong.content: Husks and zombies inflict hunger on hit.

claim.content: A zombie does not inflict hunger on hit.
claim.justification: I was hit 20 times with no hunger change.

wrong.content: A wooden pickaxe lasts 59 uses and a stone pickaxe lasts 131 uses.

claim.content: A stone pickaxe lasts 132 uses.
claim.justification: I counted 132 blocks mined before it broke, twice.

wrong.content: A healing potion restores 4 health and a harming potion deals 6 damage.

claim.content: A harming potion deals 6 damage only to living players, not to undead mobs.

wrong.content: Creepers and phantoms flee from cats.

claim.content: A phantom ignores cats and attacks the player anyway.
claim.justification: I stood next to my cat and a phantom dived at me.

wrong.content: A bed needs 3 wool and 3 planks, and a torch needs 1 coal and 1 stick.

claim.content: A bed needs 3 wool and 4 planks.

wrong.content: Endermen teleport when hit by arrows and when hit by snowballs.

claim.content: An enderman does not react to a snowball hit.

wrong.content: A player has 20 health and 20 hunger points.

claim.content: A player has 10 hunger points.
claim.justification: The debug screen read a food level of 10 at the start of the world, three times.

wrong.content: Zombies spawn in light level 7 or below, and creepers spawn in light level 7 or below.

claim.content: Creepers spawn in light level 0 only.
claim.justification: I tested rooms with level 1 to 7 for an hour, and none spawned.
